findings.evidence: The Files panel renders only when `explorer` is truthy (`{explorer && filesMounted && (...)}` at Sidebar.tsx:142-153) while the Files tab is always rendered (SidebarTabs.tsx:17-20). Sidebar.explorer.test.tsx:56-63 renders the Sidebar with no explorer prop and asserts two tabs; selecting Files in that state would leave aria-selected=true on a tab whose aria-controls target does not exist. The real App always passes an ExplorerPanel (App.tsx:613-622), so this is not reachable in production today.
findings.description: The Sidebar contract allows a Files tab with no Files panel. If `explorer` is ever omitted, the selected Files tab controls no panel, contradicting the tab/tabpanel pairing R5 asks for. Either hide the Files tab when there is nothing to show, or render a named empty/hint panel in that case. Advisory because the app shell never renders Sidebar without an explorer.

verifications.evidence: SidebarTabs.tsx:35-44 (mount effect) now gives each library-rendered tab id=sidebarTabId(value) and aria-controls=sidebarPanelId(value); Sidebar.tsx:125-128 (Projects) and Sidebar.tsx:144-148 (Files) give each role=tabpanel the matching id plus aria-labelledby=sidebarTabId. Sidebar.tabs.test.tsx:299-314 asserts the id/aria-controls/aria-labelledby round-trip for both tabs with distinct ids; the suite passes (npx vitest run src/features/apps/Sidebar.tabs.test.tsx: 26 tests pass).
